title: Add CLI option coverage
description: Create a maintainable CLI integration test matrix that exercises the command options supported by a local ledger, including JSON output, filters, mutation actors, lifecycle options, diagnostics, and the command groups that do not require external GitHub credentials or a long-running dashboard.
acceptance: CLI tests exercise each supported local command option at least once, including global --root and --json where applicable.
Tests cover success and diagnostic behavior for lifecycle, issue, handoff, prompt, message, validation, index, report, sync, repair, and git command options.
External GitHub API and long-running MCP/dashboard server startup are explicitly isolated rather than making the suite network-dependent.
bun test, typecheck, Biome check, and ledger validation pass.
notes: Scope intentionally excludes live GitHub API calls and persistent server startup. Use isolated fixture ledgers and child-process CLI invocations.
